content.subject: Quick question about month-end close
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. I'm reaching out because month-end close reconciliation may be an area we could help with.

I read your post announcing your new CFO role, especially your point about the excitement of scaling while maintaining fulfillment quality. I imagine keeping reconciliation records aligned across multiple systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We build a data-matching engine that extracts transaction data from source systems and aligns entries, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
